english_item: WauTrace felt like a friendly and engaging guide to Wau Kikik.
psychometric_validation: Not established for this adapted wording.
adaptation_rationale: The wording describes WauTrace as a friendly and engaging guide to Wau Kikik. It preserves both descriptors in the authorised item; it is not claimed to be a single judgement or a measure of avatar attractiveness.

english_item: WauTrace’s greeting made me feel welcome when I started.
psychometric_validation: Not established for this adapted wording.
adaptation_rationale: Connects feeling welcome to the opening greeting; it does not ask separate judgements about time, name or avatar.

psychometric_validation: Not established for this adapted wording.

adaptation_rationale: Measures how clearly the opening message communicates what WauTrace can explain about Wau Kikik, within the purpose and scope construct.

english_item: I could not tell what WauTrace was meant to help me with.

english_item: WauTrace understood my questions about Wau Kikik.
psychometric_validation: Not established for this adapted wording.
adaptation_rationale: Measures recognition of users’ Wau Kikik questions; understanding a question is not equated with historical answer accuracy.

english_item: WauTrace failed to recognise many of my questions.
psychometric_validation: Not established for this adapted wording.
adaptation_rationale: Preserves failure to recognise many user questions and the item’s negative polarity.

english_item: WauTrace’s answers were useful, relevant and informative.
psychometric_validation: Not established for this adapted wording.
adaptation_rationale: The authorised wording combines useful, relevant and informative in one response. It is not claimed to be a single judgement; these descriptors do not establish historical accuracy or learning gains.

english_item: WauTrace’s answers were unrelated to what I asked.
psychometric_validation: Not established for this adapted wording.
adaptation_rationale: Measures irrelevance to the user’s question without adding a judgement of style.

english_item: When my question was unclear, WauTrace helped me get back on track.
psychometric_validation: Not established for this adapted wording.
response_condition: The participant attempts an ambiguous question in their own words and then clarifies it. Rate the actual recovery, including unsuccessful recovery; success is not assumed.
ui_link_note: The wording is conditional on unclear input; clarification is the planned recovery feature, not an extra phrase inserted into the item.
adaptation_rationale: Measures recovery from an unclear question. The study task invites participants to use their own wording and clarify their intended topic without supplying a scripted test sentence.

english_item: WauTrace handled problems in our conversation poorly.
psychometric_validation: Not established for this adapted wording.
adaptation_rationale: Measures poor handling of conversational problems. An evidence-grounded refusal is not automatically treated as a failure.
